# The neuralLink fixture dispatches to the page's own App Worker

Part of #20370 (linked natively); graduated from D#18775, option G. Blocked by the seam leaf, which provides the test entry.

## Context

With the test entry in place, the whitebox fixture still reaches the API only through a Bridge. This leaf gives it a second path: dispatch to the page's own dedicated App Worker, with no Brain checkout and no socket.

## The Architectural Reality

- `test/playwright/fixtures.mjs` provides the `neuralLink` fixture, which throws unless `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` names a Brain checkout.
- `test/playwright/e2e/core/AiClientLateBridge.spec.mjs` already captures and evaluates the page's App Worker: the precedent for addressing.
- Binding by app name went wrong once: `waitForSession(appName)` returned the oldest same-name session (#19713, fixed by #19715 in the fixture). The adapter keeps its own worker handle and never looks an app up by name.
- `Client#handleAgentDisconnected` (`src/ai/Client.mjs:272`) releases the writer's locks and sweeps its transactions, keyed on the full pair.

## The Fix

1. A harness-owned adapter in the test tree (never `src/main/addon/`): boots the page with the test flag, captures its dedicated App Worker, and calls the test entry.
2. Each test gets a fresh fixture-minted `{agentId, sessionId}` pair. Fixture teardown ends that pair through `handleAgentDisconnected`, including when the test throws.
3. The fixture picks the adapter when no Brain checkout is configured; with `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` set, the Bridge path is unchanged.

## Discussion Criteria Mapping & Leaf Slice

Option G (dedicated worker first, no app-name search), OQ6's mechanism (the spec is in the contract-specs leaf), and STEP_BACK point 3. No binding inventory belongs to this leaf.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] With no `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT`, a spec against a real source app on a dedicated worker reads and writes through the adapter, and the page opens no WebSocket.
- [ ] Each test runs under its own fixture-minted pair, and teardown ends it through `handleAgentDisconnected` even when the test throws.
- [ ] The adapter addresses the captured worker and never searches by app name.
- [ ] Specs run with `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` set behave unchanged.
- [ ] `learn/guides/testing/WhiteboxE2E.md` says which path a run takes and how to choose it.

## Out of Scope

The contract specs, CI selection, SharedWorker apps (residual leaf), and any production main-thread API.

## Decision Record

`Decision Record:` Not needed (D#18775).
